_doc: Corrections to the generated command schemas that the OpenSeesPy docs cannot express. Applied by build_runtime_schemas.py. Key: `command` or `command/Type`. Fields: `args` replaces the whole list; `length` sets a vec's length (a number, 'ndm', 'ndf', 'dynamic', or {ref: <earlier count arg>, times?}); `kind` retypes an arg; an arg may carry `ndm: 2|3` to apply to one model dimension only; `word` marks string args that are never numbers. `_why` is documentation only.

beamIntegration/FixedLocation._why: N is followed by N section tags and N locations (OpenSees beamIntegration docs).

beamIntegration/MidDistance._why: N is followed by N section tags and N locations (OpenSees beamIntegration docs).

beamIntegration/LowOrder._why: N is followed by N section tags, locations and weights.

beamIntegration/UserDefined._why: N is followed by N section tags, locations and weights.

beamIntegration/UserHinge._why: npL / npR count each hinge's section tags, locations and weights.

mesh/line._why: numnodes counts the entries of *ndtags; eleType is the string name of an element, not an int.

mesh/quad._why: numlines counts the entries of *ltags; eleType is the string name of an element, not an int.

mesh/tri._why: numlines counts the entries of *ltags; eleType is the string name of an element, not an int.

mesh/tet._why: nummesh counts the entries of *mtags; eleType is the string name of an element, not an int.

mesh/bg._why: lower / upper are ndm coordinates; locations and snodes are counted by numl and numnodes.

mesh/part._why: pArgs, eleType and eleArgs depend on the part type and cannot be split positionally, so they are kept as one list. The type arg is named partType because `type` is the command's own type choice.

uniaxialMaterial/Hysteretic._why: Each of p1..p3 / n1..n3 is a (stress, strain) pair.

nDMaterial/PressureDependMultiYield._why: dilat and liquefac are 2 values each; yieldSurf is (gamma, G/Gmax) pairs, 2 per surface; params is 4 values.

nDMaterial/PressureDependMultiYield02._why: yieldSurf is 2 values per surface; liquefac 2; params 4.

responseSpectrumAnalysis._why: The extractor kept `<'-scale ', scale>` as one malformed arg (trailing space, angle brackets). Only the tsTag form is kept; the Tn/Sa list form has no stable positional layout.

setParameter._why: Optional <> groups were parsed as positional args. Parameter-specific trailing *args are not modelled.

printModel._why: Doc signature mixes -node's id list and -flag. Checked against OpenSeesPy: printModel('-node', 1) and ('-ele', 1) take id lists.

block2D._why: eleArgs length depends on the element type and crds follows it, so they cannot be split positionally; kept as one list.

block3D._why: eleArgs length depends on the element type and crds follows it, so they cannot be split positionally; kept as one list.

geomTransf/Linear._why: The docs list *vecxz after the -jntOffset values; it comes before the flag (3D only, 0 or 3 values). dI and dJ are one offset per dimension.

geomTransf/PDelta._why: The docs list *vecxz after the -jntOffset values; it comes before the flag (3D only, 0 or 3 values). dI and dJ are one offset per dimension.

geomTransf/Corotational._why: The docs list *vecxz after the -jntOffset values; it comes before the flag (3D only, 0 or 3 values). dI and dJ are one offset per dimension.

recorder/Node._why: respType (disp, vel, accel, reaction, ...) is always a word, which is what ends the preceding -dof list.

recorder/EnvelopeNode._why: respType (disp, vel, accel, reaction, ...) is always a word, which is what ends the preceding -dof list.

section/Elastic._why: The 2D layout is `E A Iz [G alphaY]` and the 3D layout is `E A Iz Iy G J [alphaY alphaZ]` (OpenSees rejects the 2D form in 3D). The docs list the two signatures without saying which is which, so each arg carries the ndm it applies to.

section/ElasticMembranePlateSection._why: The docs type E, nu, h, rho and the optional plate modifier as strings; they are numbers, in this order (`E nu h rho [Ep_modifier]`).
